accounting_unit: one GPU allocated for one minute
policy_note: Current mode is non-commercial research and development in the GitHub development environment, not a commercial production service. Provider terms must permit this specific current use. Commercial-use rights are not a qualification requirement now. The 86,400 GPU-minute/month figure is only a provisional planning reference, not a validated requirement or proven available amount; its feasibility must be determined empirically and the reference may be revised or abandoned. Free/no-card eligibility, automation, workload compatibility, data handling, actual allocation, fresh capacity and reliability still require evidence. Switching to commercial production requires requalification. Sensitive or private prompts must not be sent to unapproved community-operated providers.

providers.name: lightning_ai

official_sources.supports: Current pricing page: up to 30 free credits can provide about 80 GPU hours to start, depending on GPU pricing; the FAQ says 5 credits are granted at registration and 25 additional credits require adding a card. It also advertises one free CPU Studio with a restart every four hours.
The AI Studio guide conflicts with the pricing page: it says phone verification unlocks 80 free GPU hours and 15 free credits each month; availability can vary by country.

advertised.notes: The official pricing page says up to 30 starter credits can yield about 80 GPU hours to start, but its FAQ says only 5 credits are granted on registration and adding a card unlocks 25 more. The separate official AI Studio guide instead claims 80 GPU hours and 15 free credits each month after phone verification. These public sources conflict on recurrence and the no-card allowance. Do not infer that 80 GPU hours are available without a card, convert the headline into monthly GPU-minutes, or count recurring capacity until current account-specific balance, selected GPU pricing, terms and an actual allocation are verified.

notes: Potential starting GPU capacity worth testing for R&D, subject to phone verification, account eligibility, selected GPU pricing and current allowance.
